issue_context.title: C++ callback API: Don't check "*wanted_" and initiate ops under lock in BindCall/etc
issue_context.body:
A suggestion from @soheilhy on #18856 is to extract the actual initiation of server-side operations like Finish/Read/etc from the critical sections used in BindCall/etc. We can migrate the various bools into a packed struct (with pad words to power-of-2 to allow a single instruction copy/zero without thin-air-writes) and then just copy that out during the critical section and operate on a local copy after that point.


### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
Potential performance issue
### Describe the solution you'd like
As described above
### Describe alternatives you've considered
Current solution initiates operations from within the critical section
### Additional context

review_comments: same here, I think scoped-MutexLock would suffice.
does this have to be releasable now?

So.... I kept this Releasable so that I don't have to construct an empty PreBindOperations and then set it up by move assignment since Status is not constexpr-constructible. We should probably change that part and make OK status constexpr-constructible (e.g., only have the strings in place when they are used)
So, yeah, I kept the TODO in only one place but meant it for all of them. I should make that clear.
